# Dentoku Dev

> Dentoku Dev is a software studio in Milan, Italy. It builds custom software that automates the repetitive work of small businesses: answering customer email, preparing quotes, retyping data between tools, and handling bookings and orders. Every project starts from how many hours a month the problem costs today, and after release the hours are counted again with the client. The studio also makes four products of its own: three Chrome extensions and a Shopify app.

The studio works with online shops, professional practices, vacation rentals, and agencies and studios, remotely, in Italian and English. The site is bilingual: English at the root, Italian under /it.

## What the studio automates
- Answering customer email: the software reads incoming requests and drafts a reply in the business's tone; a person reads it and presses Send.
- Preparing quotes: the request is matched against the price list and the quote is filled in the business's own format, ready to check.
- Retyping data between tools: data moves between the tools already in use (email, spreadsheets, management software, Shopify) without anyone retyping it.
- Handling bookings and orders: requests and confirmations are collected, the calendar is updated and reminders are sent.

## How a project works
1. A short call and a written proposal: what is built, what it costs, when it ships, and how many hours a month the problem costs today. No obligation until the client approves it.
2. Design and build in short cycles, with working software to try from the first weeks.
3. After launch, a direct line to the people who wrote the code.
4. After release, the monthly hours are counted again, together.

## Products
- EmailMagnet: https://www.dentokudev.com/emailmagnet
  Chrome extension for finding and extracting emails from websites while browsing.
- ClickPilot AI: https://www.dentokudev.com/clickpilot-ai
  Chrome extension for fixing, rewriting, summarizing, translating, and transforming text inside browser fields.
- Volume Control PRO: https://www.dentokudev.com/volume-control-pro
  Chrome extension for boosting tab audio up to 600% and managing browser volume by site.
- Countdown321: https://www.dentokudev.com/countdown321
  Shopify app for countdown timers and time-based storefront urgency messages.
- All products: https://www.dentokudev.com/overview
